The camera cuts between a wide shot of the room, a medium shot of the woman (Kristi Noem), and a medium shot of the representative (Seth Magaziner). At one point, the representative holds up a tablet showing another man's face on a video call.

cast.name: Kristi Noem
cast.evidence: She is identified by face recognition and in the on-screen text: "Democrat Rep. confronts Kristi Noem..." She is questioned directly throughout the video.

cast.evidence: He is the Democratic Representative speaking throughout the clip. A nameplate in front of him reads "MR. MAGAZINER".

cast.name: Sae Joon Park
cast.evidence: He is the subject of the confrontation, a veteran who the representative claims was deported. He is named repeatedly in the audio: "a gentleman named Sae Joon Park."

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official @democrats account and features a Democratic representative confronting a Republican governor.

on_screen_text.text: Democrat Rep. confronts Kristi Noem on deporting Purple Heart recipient

spoken_summary: A Democratic representative asks Kristi Noem how many U.S. military veterans she has deported. Noem replies that they have not deported military veterans. The representative then presents the case of Sae Joon Park, a U.S. Army combat veteran and Purple Heart recipient who was shot twice serving in Panama. He explains that Park struggled with PTSD and substance abuse after his service, leading to minor drug offenses, but has been sober for 14 years. The representative states that Noem's administration deported Park to Korea, a country he hadn't lived in since he was seven, and asks Noem to thank him for his service.
audio_music: The video consists entirely of spoken dialogue from the congressional hearing, with no music or sound effects.
editing_pacing: The video consists of cuts between different camera angles of a congressional hearing, following the conversation between the two main speakers. Large, yellow text captions appear on screen in sync with the dialogue.
central_claim: Kristi Noem deported Sae Joon Park, a decorated and wounded U.S. Army combat veteran, revealing a lack of respect for military service.
intended_effect: To generate anger towards Kristi Noem and portray her as hypocritical and cruel, particularly regarding her treatment of military veterans.
